title: WorkPulse CDC employments row v1
description: Captured `employments` interval columns — the as-of dimension source for attributable facts. The row id is deliberately not captured; intervals are keyed by employee and `effective_from`.

tenant_id.description: Tenant the row belongs to — enforced end-to-end.

employee_id.description: Employee the interval belongs to (UUIDv7 string).

department_id.description: Department in effect for the interval.

position_id.description: Position in effect for the interval.

location_id.description: Location in effect for the interval.

effective_from.description: First day of the interval (inclusive), Debezium epoch-day encoding.

effective_to.description: First day after the interval (end-exclusive), Debezium epoch-day encoding; null while open. A transfer closes the old period at the new period's effective_from.
